description: This file defines the AuthAPI class and related data structures for handling authentication, token management, and user info retrieval in a Swift application. It includes methods for login, token refresh, logout, and fetching user details, interacting with a backend API.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: Singleton class providing authentication-related API calls such as login, refresh, logout, and fetching user info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password, returns a TokenPair.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and invalidates the refresh token on the backend.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user information from the backend.

methods.name: mapTokenResponseToTokenPair
methods.description: Converts backend token response to TokenPair with absolute expiry date.

methods.name: requireHTTP
methods.description: Ensures response is an HTTPURLResponse, throws error otherwise.
